step_by_step_reasoning:
1. Identify visual nodes from the whiteboard: CloudFront, S3, API Gateway, ECS, DynamoDB, Step Functions, and EC2 (labeled HPC). External users (3M scientists/engineers) interact with the application from the left edge.
2. Trace entry points: External user traffic enters top-left into CloudFront, and CI/CD code triggers enter bottom-left into Step Functions.
3. Trace data/control flows from visual arrows:
   - User -> CloudFront -> API Gateway -> ECS -> DynamoDB (auth/config) & EC2 (job execution).
   - User -> Step Functions -> DynamoDB (definitions) & EC2 (HPC model deployment).
   - EC2 -> S3 (storing job results).
   - S3 -> User (delivering web app SPA and model output results).

graph.name: 3M - Internal Modeling and HPC Platform
graph.notes: Internal web application built on serverless architecture (CloudFront, API Gateway, ECS, DynamoDB, Step Functions, S3) powering an EC2-based HPC cluster for 3M scientists.

nodes.name: 3M Scientists & Engineers
nodes.notes: Internal users authenticating and interacting with the modeling platform

nodes.name: CloudFront
nodes.notes: Fronts web app entry point and handles edge authentication

nodes.name: S3
nodes.notes: Hosts single page web app assets and stores model execution results

nodes.name: API Gateway
nodes.notes: Fronts API requests with additional authorization

nodes.name: DynamoDB
nodes.notes: Stores front-end configurations, access control, and model metadata

nodes.name: Step Functions
nodes.notes: Orchestrates CI/CD workflow for model publishing

nodes.name: EC2 HPC Cluster
nodes.notes: High performance computing environment executing physics and ML models

edges.notes: User accesses web application via CloudFront
CloudFront routes API calls to API Gateway
API Gateway forwards authorized requests to ECS API layer
ECS queries DynamoDB for configurations and authorization
ECS instantiates model execution job on EC2 HPC cluster
HPC cluster publishes completed model results to S3
User retrieves SPA web assets and model results from S3
Scientist submits model via repository push to trigger Step Functions workflow
Step Functions publishes model definitions into DynamoDB
Step Functions deploys model execution files into EC2 HPC cluster
